title: UNDER GOD'S SHADOW
PSALM 121:7-8 PRAYER
end: The Covenant Shield — walk under God's daily covering
stock_queries: golden light rays through dramatic mountain clouds
ancient stone watchtower golden sunset light
calm mountain lake sunset sky reflections
majestic mountain peak bathed in divine sunlight

scenes.a: Place every step, every journey, and every unseen concern under the shadow of the Almighty today.
When uncertainty surrounds your path, rest in His holy promise.

Scripture declares in Psalm 121:7-8: "The Lord shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul. The Lord shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore."
Father, shield this believer from all hidden snares and cover every path they walk today.
Guard their mind in perfect peace, protect their home, and surround them with holy angels continuously.
Walk securely beneath His eternal canopy, knowing His loving protection over you never slumbers or sleeps. Subscribe to The Covenant Shield to walk under God's covering.
